the design, docking studies and binding mode analysis of a series of pyrazole derivatives as possible NNRTIs.
the molecular docking studies of novel pyrazoles as possible inhibitors of HIV-1 RT.
the molecular docking studies of  484 novel pyrazoles analogs as possible NNRTIs of HIV-1 RT.

the novel pyrazole derivatives are potential HIV-1- RT inhibitors and can be further explored for the design of new and potent anti-HIV agents.

we have designed and docked 484 novel pyrrole analogs as possible HIV-1- RT inhibitors.
the novel pyrazole derivatives with aryl groups substituted in the phenyl ring could be a potential HIV-1 RT inhibitors.

the novel pyrazole compounds can act as potential HIV-1- RT inhibitors and can be used in the design and discovery of newer NMEs.
